mintAuthority.summary: CASH's canonical issuance is on Solana: the Token-2022 mint is controlled through Bridge program BkP8..., with a native backend route, reserve-ledger checks, allowances, and a 20-million-CASH per-call limit. Bridge governance can change native roles and limits immediately, while the current single-key Bridge program upgrader can replace mint logic without delay. HyperEVM and LayerZero transfer machinery is assessed separately under Bridge Risk and is not part of this canonical mint posture.

controls.label: CASH Bridge program native backend mint surface
controls.capDescription: The native Bridge path applies a 20,000,000-CASH per-call limit. Backend EOA 3ZGf... had 228,398,515.21 CASH remaining allowance at the 2026-07-13 cutoff; governance EOA E7Jd... can change native roles, allowances, the per-call limit, and the 1-billion-CASH maximum allowance immediately.
bypassSurfaces: Governance EOA E7JdFMP5AqdndJKstZV2mHdekLwAQbNWRHMpoozyB3qw can change roles and limits immediately.
Program upgrader 76m8dWSAYTuNWMfZS5tR1Az8sYnCGkEJ8WYWJhxAhQ5Q can replace Bridge mint logic with no delay.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439714474, the CASH Token-2022 mint's mintAuthority was the Bridge-controlled PDA HJT2TXr..., confirming the native Bridge issuance path. The native backend route requires an active recipient role, reserve-ledger mint RD1S..., an unpaused config, remaining allowance, and the 20-million per-call bound; the 2026-07-13 fixed-cutoff read recorded backend EOA 3ZGf... with 228,398,515.21 CASH allowance. The separate LayerZero OFTStore route is bridge machinery and is recorded under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: CASH Bridge governance and native mint-policy EOA
controls.evidence: At the cutoff, Bridge GlobalConfig named this on-curve funded system account as governance. It can immediately transfer governance, grant or revoke minter and recipient roles, reset allowances, change per-transaction and maximum-allowance limits, and pause minting. The same address is the CASH permanent-delegate, mint-close, and confidential-transfer authority; separate token-extension authorities do not add mint capability.

controls.label: CASH Bridge program single-key upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 442198055, Bridge ProgramData H79WsaPgtctdpmhykRQZ91r8HNr5uqxUWEBe6DZXuhMu named 76m8dWSAYTuNWMfZS5tR1Az8sYnCGkEJ8WYWJhxAhQ5Q as its current upgrade authority. The prior 6HZHZvHV... value was a decoding error: that 32-byte slice began at the bincode Option tag at offset 12 instead of the authority key at offset 13. The corrected authority is an on-curve public key with no live account data at the cutoff, so Solana exposes a direct externally signable authority rather than an on-chain multisig or timelock. Successful transaction 23biLsr... at slot 401157588 records the transfer from BozdeW... to 76m8d.... This authority can replace native Bridge mint logic immediately and invalidate every current allowance check.

AeLm... is authority index 1 (bump 254) of Squads V3 multisig BnD53519LK7QM4ERBGvLedZDe1VoTPgtiBkGPWAACiMZ, whose current account data reports threshold 4 and six members. The latest Token-2022 upgrade at slot 427147035 executed through Squads transaction AMwAZJaEc3Rc7zt85Kn9nJQFcCZMzxHt96rsDcQUk4d2 with four recorded approvals. Squads V3 has no execution-delay field or module/guard layer, and its own ProgramData currently has no upgrade authority.

review.evidence: At the current reviewed boundary, only Solana native issuance is compiled here: the Bridge-controlled Token-2022 mint uses a reserve-ledger-backed backend path with immediately changeable governance and current no-delay Bridge-program upgradeability. HyperEVM CASH, the Solana OFTStore, LayerZero OApp/Endpoint, peers, limits, and route administrators are bridge machinery and are scored separately under bridgeRouteRisk. No whole-supply CASH reserve reconciliation is evidenced; the official policy statement is not a dated CASH-specific reserve-to-liability report or prudential supervision, so reconciliation remains unknown. 2026-08-21 reconciliation update: that gap is now closed. Bridge's Open Issuance transparency page for CASH (accessed 2026-08-21) publishes a continuously updated whole-supply reserves comparison, showing supply 119,013,344 CASH against reserves of $119,014,177 with composition 7% cash and 93% T-bills, page updated 2026-08-21 13:50 UTC. That live feed reconciles the complete CASH liability against reserve assets, so reconciliation moves from unknown to continuous. Supervision stays none: no prudential supervisor is named, and the reconciliation is issuer-published rather than examined by an independent attestor. 2026-08-28 control refresh: current ProgramData decodes corrected the CASH Bridge authority from the option-byte-inclusive 6HZHZvHV... slice to the on-curve direct authority 76m8dWSA..., and corrected the shared Token-2022 authority from the option-byte-inclusive 768jbfNJ... slice to AeLmXCb..., authority index 1 of a program-immutable Squads V3 deployment; currently 4-of-6, zero-delay; the latest Token-2022 upgrade recorded four approvals.
